text:
dylan_sales: Quick handoff for NimbusBank (closed $300k ARR, regional bank). Contract signed today; 12-month term with 6-week pilot. Key constraints: PCI scope, VPC peering for EU region, SSO via SAML, and audit log exports to customer's S3. Pilot success metrics: demo users = 2k MAU, median latency <180ms, and zero P0 security findings.

keisha_csm: Taking CSM. I'll own kickoff and weekly check-ins. Can legal confirm exact language for data export? Also need expected internal SPOC from Nimbus for infra and security.

dylan_sales: Nimbus contact: claire@nimbusbank.com (PM), sec-ops@nimbusbank.com for compliance. Legal already flagged a small change re: audit log retention; Sara will handle.

omar_se: SE notes: their workload is short transactional prompts (avg 120 tokens) but high QPS spikes during business hours. Recommend rdx-7b with autoscale policy + prefix caching. Need sample event rates and a list of prioritized endpoints.

lina_onboard: I'll run developer sandbox and two enablement sessions: (1) API walkthrough + SDKs, (2) Security & SSO runthrough with Nimbus sec-ops. Propose dates: sandbox by 2025-04-03, sessions week of 2025-04-07. Who provides SAML metadata?

tom_support: Support triage owner assigned. Please add escalation contact and include PagerDuty group. We'll produce an incident runbook tailored to PCI-sensitive flows.

sara_compliance: I'll push the counter-signature for data export clause; need to confirm retention window (they asked 24 months). Also request a short questionnaire from Nimbus on data classification.

dylan_sales: Owners: CSM=@keisha_csm, SE=@omar_se, Onboarding=@lina_onboard, Support=@tom_support, Compliance=@sara_compliance. Pilot go-live target 2025-04-10.

keisha_csm: Action list I captured: 1) Nimbus to send SAML metadata and S3 export destination by 2025-03-25. 2) Omar to run load test in sandbox and post results by 2025-03-30. 3) Lina to deliver onboarding runbook + invites by 2025-03-28. 4) Sara to update legal countersign by 2025-03-27. 5) Tom to attach support runbook (PCI) by 2025-04-05.

omar_se: Starting load test. Sample curl for their engineers to generate realistic traffic:

```
for i in {1..1000}; do \
  curl -s -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rdx-7b","input":"{\"transaction\":\"pay 42.50 USD to vendor\"}","max_tokens":64}' &
done
```

lina_onboard: Calendar invites sent. Added checklist: SDK install, API keys, SSO test account, export permissions. Will add runbook link here once published. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Sandbox environment nimbusbank-sbx created. CI build #452 queued. Will report status in thread.

tom_support: Added PagerDuty escalation: Support L1 -> Security Ops -> SE -> Eng oncall. Sharing runbook draft: https://confluence.redwood/nimbusbank-runbook (internal).

keisha_csm: Good progress. Low immediate renewal risk since closed, but note medium operational risk if SSO/SAML integration takes >2 weeks. I'll create the consolidated onboarding ticket and assign owners. Please update this thread when each task is done. Thanks all.
